name: Usage Pacer
description: Keeps subscription agents usable for the whole rolling window. It reads each agent's 5-hour and weekly usage, calculates deficit or reserve against an even burn rate, and selects the next model in your configured fallback ladder before a turn starts.
tagline: Spend subscription quota at a sustainable pace

fields.label: Automatically select lower-cost models
fields.description: Applies your ladder only to agents with readable subscription usage windows. It never changes an agent's saved model.

fields.label: Pacing mode
fields.description: Even burn compares usage with the remaining-window pace and applies extra pressure when you are in deficit. Usage thresholds only switches when an explicit ladder threshold is crossed.

fields.label: Agent and global ladders
fields.description: JSON configuration. Agent entries override global entries. `windows` accepts `weekly`, `session`, or `both`; `at` is used-percent. In even mode, deficit beyond `pace_deficit` adds pressure toward the next rung.
